column4: prompt   (kind: terrain | piece = white tintable | piecec = own colours | card)
Subject: a dense temperate pine and oak forest, rounded tree canopies of varied deep greens, a small winding dirt trail, a few fallen logs, a tiny woodcutter's stack of timber.
Subject: lush rolling bright green pasture with a small flock of fluffy white sheep grazing, a little blue pond, short wooden fence segments, a few wildflowers. Fresh light spring green dominates.
Subject: ripe golden wheat fields laid out in parallel strips of slightly different golden tones, a few bound sheaves standing, a narrow farm path. Warm golden yellow dominates.
Subject: terraced red-orange clay hills with an open clay pit, neat stacks of fired red bricks drying in rows, a small round brick kiln. Terracotta red-orange dominates.
Subject: rugged grey rocky mountains with snow-dusted peaks seen from above, scree slopes, a small mine entrance with a cart track and glints of dark blue-grey ore. Cool slate grey dominates.
Subject: an empty sandy desert with soft wind-rippled dunes, patches of cracked dry earth, a few dry shrubs and scattered pale rocks. Pale warm sand colour dominates.
Subject: open sea water only, deep teal blue with gentle evenly spread painted swells and small soft light glints, uniform texture with no focal point, no land, no boats, no foam lines.
Subject: a small house: a simple block with a pitched roof (a pentagon-shaped prism).
Subject: a wider low block building joined to a taller square tower block with a flat top, one simple solid shape.
Subject: a simple pawn figure: rounded head on a tapered body on a round disc base, with a plain round shield disc on its front.
Subject: a simple toy wagon: a rectangular block with an arched rounded cover on top and two plain disc wheels.
Subject: a simple tall hooded pawn figure, a smooth tapered cone-like body with a rounded hood, solid dark charcoal grey.
Subject: a short straight low wall block with three plain square crenellations on top, plain smooth grey stone colour, running from left to right.
Subject: a simple slender tower: a cylinder with a cone roof topped by a small ball, smooth polished gold.
Subject: three plain wooden blocks tumbled in a small heap, dark charred grey-brown colour.
Subject: a neat stack of freshly cut timber logs at the edge of a pine forest, an axe resting in a stump.
Subject: a stack of red fired bricks beside a small glowing brick kiln, a clay pit behind.
Subject: a fluffy white sheep standing beside a basket of raw wool fleece on a green hill.
Subject: a bound golden wheat sheaf standing in a sunny wheat field.
Subject: a heap of dark blue-grey ore rocks with metallic glints and a pickaxe, at a mountain mine entrance.
Subject: folded bolts of woven cloth in soft colours stacked beside a wooden loom.
Subject: a stack of leather-bound books with a rolled scroll and a quill pen on a wooden desk by candlelight.
Subject: a small open wooden chest overflowing with shining silver coins.
Subject: a brave guard in a helmet and blue cloak with a tall spear and a round shield, standing watch on a hill.
Subject: an overflowing farm cart piled with logs, bricks, wool, wheat sheaves and ore, a bountiful harvest.
Subject: a shrewd merchant in a fine robe holding up a brass balance scale, sacks of goods behind him in a market stall.
Subject: two road builders laying cobblestones on a new country road winding into the hills.
Subject: an ancient golden chalice relic glowing softly on a stone pedestal in a small chapel.
Subject: a symmetric ornamental pattern of a stylized compass rose over interlocking hexagons, deep navy blue and gold, decorative card back design.
Subject: two short stacked logs, warm medium brown bark with pale round cut ends.
Subject: two stacked rectangular bricks, terracotta red-orange.
Subject: one fluffy round ball of cream-white wool.
Subject: a small bound bundle of wheat stalks with ears on top, golden yellow, tied with a band.
Subject: one chunky faceted ore rock, dark slate blue-grey with lighter facets.
Subject: one rolled bolt of cloth, soft sky blue fabric.
Subject: one closed thick book with a plain brown leather cover and cream page edges.
Subject: a small stack of three shiny silver coins, plain faces.
Subject: calm shallow turquoise harbour water over pale sand, lighter and clearer than the open sea, soft ripples and light glints, a few smooth pebbles at one side, no boats, no structures.
Subject: one small closed plain wooden crate, warm light brown, simple planks suggested by two shallow grooves.

column4: Subject: rocky ochre hills with an open mine entrance framed by timber beams, bright veins and nuggets of gold glinting in the rock, a small mine cart on a short track. Warm glowing gold-yellow dominates.

Subject: open sea water veiled by thick soft drifting white-grey sea mist, the teal water only faintly visible through a few gaps, calm and mysterious, uniform with no focal point, no land, no boats. Pale misty grey dominates.

Subject: a small sandy islet with a cluster of three simple round thatched huts, colourful silk cloths drying on lines between poles, a short wooden jetty reaching into turquoise water at one side. Soft sand and rose-pink silk tones dominate.
Subject: a small simple ship like a classic wooden board game ship piece: a rounded hull block seen from the side with one straight round mast and one plain square sail, the bow pointing to the left.

Subject: a small simple ship like a classic wooden board game ship piece: a rounded hull block with one straight round mast and one plain square sail, plus a small square tower block with three plain crenellations on the stern, the bow pointing to the left.

Subject: a small squat round tower block with a flat top and three plain square crenellations, standing on a low rough rock, dark weathered grey-brown colour.
Subject: a simple flag: a thin straight round pole standing on a small round disc base, with one plain rectangular pennant flag with a triangular notch at its free end.
Subject: one plain chunky five-pointed star token, warm gold yellow.

Subject: one chunky simple ship anchor, dark steel blue.

Subject: a short straight section of plain grey stone wall block with three square crenellations on top.
Subject: a simple stone bridge block with one round arch, warm grey stone.
Subject: a short round stone tower block with a bright orange flame on top.

Subject: a massive curved stone sea wall protecting a small harbour town from crashing waves.

Subject: a tall carved stone obelisk standing on a grassy headland by the sea at sunset.
Subject: a tall square castle keep on a rocky crag, banners flying, clouds drifting around its top.
